title: From Taste to Capability: Building Operational Excellence Through Coffee Vocational Capacity
excerpt: Indonesia’s coffee competitiveness will not be shaped by production volume alone, but by the capability to transform quality into value. This article explores how sensory evaluation, vocational education, and hands-on coffee training can become strategic instruments for building operational excellence, strengthening industry readiness, and developing a more sustainable coffee ecosystem from local skills in Tulungagung to broader opportunities for sustainable entrepreneurship and SME innovation.
imageCaption: Turning Sensory Knowledge into Operational Capability
